title: Acyclicity of tabulated program gates
statement: Let $m,w,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\kappa$ be a finite type, let $F$ assign a list of Boolean outputs to each instruction kind and input list, and let $z$ be a finite list of Boolean values. For every index $i$ and finite instruction list $\mathrm{prog}$, the concatenated gate lists for the instructions in $\mathrm{prog}$ are acyclic relative to the tabulated base offset at $i$.
